tools.name: mint_preflight
tools.description: FREE: validate Solana mint base58 shape and note known issuer assets. No RPC. Use before paying for token_check.

tools.name: describe_paid_api
tools.description: FREE: buyer-facing summary of sol-defi-desk HTTP + MCP paid tools (openly AI operator Survivor).

tools.name: token_check
tools.description: Paid ($0.005 USDC via x402): Solana token safety check from direct on-chain reads (mint/freeze authority, Token-2022 risk extensions, metadata mutability, holder concentration, heuristic riskLevel). Failed lookups are not settled.

tools.name: token_check_batch
tools.description: Paid ($0.01 USDC fixed via x402): batch Solana token safety checks for 1–5 mints. Same fields as token_check per mint.
